ModifyBlockMultiplicative.maps_to: modify_block_multiplicative (sts2_rl/relics/paels_legion.py:42-52), self-gating on is_card_or_monster_move(props); BlockCmd.apply runs the chain for every block gain (sts2_rl/cmds.py:490-493)
ModifyBlockMultiplicative.issue: Closed 2026-07-27, re-verified 2026-08-04 (cited files had drifted to new line numbers, logic unchanged): the props gate is in the LISTENER. `HookSystem.modify_damage_additive` / `modify_damage_multiplicative` take a `props` argument and pass it to every listener (sts2_rl/hooks.py:694-768), and DamageCmd.deal runs both chains UNCONDITIONALLY (sts2_rl/cmds.py:332-338) -- Hook.ModifyDamageInternal has no props gate of its own (Hook.cs:2515-2538). BlockCmd.apply is the same shape: no `is_powered_attack` hoist, both block chains run for every gain with props forwarded (sts2_rl/cmds.py:456-503), matching Hook.ModifyBlock (Hook.cs:1310-1340). sts2_rl/relics/paels_legion.py:42-52 is the ported method: `is_card_or_monster_move(props)`, owner's card-sourced block, awake (cooldown 0), ×2, latching `_affected_card`.

AfterModifyingBlockAmount.maps_to: after_modify_block_amount (paels_legion.py:53-66), a DEDICATED method dispatched by HookSystem.after_modify_block_amount (hooks.py:840-858) from BlockCmd.apply (cmds.py:499-500) only when a listener actually changed the block amount
AfterModifyingBlockAmount.rationale: STALE 2026-07-30 (see guard G4, closed by the same fix); re-verified 2026-08-04 after another round of line drift, logic unchanged. This entry's premise -- that the latch is collapsed into modify_block_multiplicative with neither of C#'s two extra guards -- no longer describes the code: the sim has a genuinely SEPARATE `after_modify_block_amount` method, matching the C# hook split one-for-one, with both guards reproduced (`if amount <= 0: return` at paels_legion.py:60, citing PaelsLegion.cs:157; `if self._affected_card is not None and self._affected_card is not card: return` at :64, citing PaelsLegion.cs:165), and hooks.py only invokes it for listeners in the `modifiers` list the multiplicative/additive chains build from a non-1/non-0 delta (hooks.py:855-858), matching Hook.cs:653's `modifiers.Contains(modifier)` filter. EXECUTED (`.superpowers/sdd/unlabelled/probes/relic-6-checks.py`): a block gain that resolves to 0 does NOT arm the cooldown (probe_paels_legion_latch_zero); a second card's block gain does NOT steal an already-latched card's slot (probe_paels_legion_latch_nested); an asleep relic (factor 1.0, not an active modifier) is not notified at all (probe_paels_legion_modifiers_gate). PROMPT.md bug class 15's collapse is gone -- this record's own text was simply written before the fix landed and never regenerated.

AfterCardPlayed.maps_to: on_card_played (paels_legion.py:45-49), dispatched by HookSystem.on_card_played from CombatState._resolve_card_play (combat.py:1209)
AfterCardPlayed.rationale: PaelsLegion.cs:173-185: if the latched play is this play, clear the latch and set `Cooldown = base.DynamicVars["Turns"].IntValue` -- CanonicalVars pins Turns at 2m (PaelsLegion.cs:118), matching COOLDOWN_TURNS = 2 (paels_legion.py:27). The sim compares CARD identity where C# compares CARD PLAY identity, which is equivalent for the single-play case and for the replay case (the sim's play-count loop reuses one Card object and fires on_card_played once, combat.py:1060-1209). Flash(), the pet's BlockTrigger animation (line 182) and TriggeredBlockLastTurn (:183, read only by the sleep/wake animations at :199-206) are presentation. (2026-08-04: combat.py's _resolve_card_play grew substantially; re-verified the on_card_played dispatch is still gated the same way, on `not self.is_over`.)

AfterSideTurnStart.rationale: TIMING: C# ticks the cooldown at AfterSideTurnStart, i.e. the POST-draw turn-start slot (audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json step 23), which the sim spells on_player_turn_started; paels_legion.py:51 uses on_player_turn_start, the PRE-draw slot (~step 18, established by execution -- `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py turn-order` prints on_player_turn_start BEFORE modify_hand_draw, which is PROMPT.md bug class 11's whole point). VALUE: C# is `bool flag = Cooldown > 0; Cooldown--;` unconditionally (PaelsLegion.cs:191-192), so the counter goes NEGATIVE on every awake turn; the sim decrements only while positive. Both differences are non-observable and that is why this is a divergence rather than a gap. The negative values are read only by `Cooldown > 0` (:148, :199) and by DisplayAmount, which floors at -1 anyway (:68-72), so clamping at 0 is observationally identical. The slot difference needs a block gain BETWEEN the two slots to matter -- i.e. block from a card auto-played during the turn-start draw. That shape exists (HellraiserPower auto-plays a drawn Strike, powers.py:1030-1049; MayhemPower auto-plays from the draw pile at after_auto_pre_play_phase_entered, powers.py:4477-4497) but neither can gain block: Hellraiser fires only on cards tagged 'strike', and Mayhem runs in the auto-pre-play phase, AFTER both turn-start slots. (2026-08-04: re-verified after powers.py line drift -- both classes still exist with the same gating.) So no ported path can observe the difference today. Recorded as a divergence per binding rule 2 (same observable outcome) with the residual risk named: porting a draw-time auto-play of a block card, or any BeforeHandDraw/ModifyHandDraw listener that gains card block, makes the slot difference observable and this verdict must then be re-audited as a gap.

AfterCombatEnd.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the per-combat reset exists. `Relic.reset_for_combat` is declared on the base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:215-228) and `Relic.attach` runs it every time the relic joins a new CombatState (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:247-250) -- one sim boundary standing in for the three C# spells it (AfterCombatEnd / BeforeCombatStart / AfterRoomEntered(CombatRoom)), and it also covers the hole AfterCombatEnd alone leaves when a fight ends inside play_card. sts2_rl/relics/paels_legion.py:37-40 clears BOTH behavioural fields, `cooldown` and `_affected_card` (PaelsLegion.cs:211-219; base.Status and TriggeredBlockLastTurn are presentation). WAS: nothing in the sim ever put the flag back, so the relic worked in the first combat of a run only.

guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-27, re-verified 2026-08-04 (line drift only): the props gate is in the LISTENER. `HookSystem.modify_damage_additive` / `modify_damage_multiplicative` take a `props` argument and pass it to every listener (sts2_rl/hooks.py:694-768), and DamageCmd.deal runs both chains UNCONDITIONALLY (sts2_rl/cmds.py:332-338) -- Hook.ModifyDamageInternal has no props gate of its own (Hook.cs:2515-2538). BlockCmd.apply is the same shape: no `is_powered_attack` hoist, both block chains run for every gain, with props forwarded (sts2_rl/cmds.py:456-503), matching Hook.ModifyBlock (Hook.cs:1310-1340). sts2_rl/relics/paels_legion.py:46-47 self-gates on `is_card_or_monster_move(props)`, which is PaelsLegion.cs:136's `props.IsCardOrMonsterMove()` -- Move alone, NOT the Dexterity/Frail-style powered-only predicate. guards.what: G3 (DORMANT): the sim adds a `target is not self.player` check that C#'s ModifyBlockMultiplicative does not have
guards.issue: MECHANISM: PaelsLegion.cs:134-153 checks props, cardSource and cardSource.Owner -- and NOTHING about the target. So in C#, a card played by the owner that grants block to any creature has that block doubled, including a creature that is not the player. paels_legion.py:40 requires `target is self.player`. REACHABILITY (DORMANT, with the concrete unported thing named): every ported card-sourced block gain targets `ctx.player` (`grep -rn 'BlockCmd.apply' sts2_rl/cards/` -- 20 sites, all `ctx.player`), and the only ported non-player block gains are monster moves and powers with `card=None`, which C#'s own `cardSource == null` bail (line 140) already excludes. Porting a player card that grants block to an enemy, or any player-side summon/minion a card could shield, makes it live. Recorded as a gap rather than a waiver: 'no ported card does this' is today's content, not the divergence's shape (binding rule 1).

guards.what: G4 (DORMANT): the latch. C# latches in AfterModifyingBlockAmount behind two extra guards (`modifiedAmount > 0` and 'a different play already latched'); the sim latches inside the multiplicative itself with neither
guards.rationale: CLOSED 2026-07-30, re-verified 2026-08-04 (line drift only, same shape): the sim no longer latches inside `modify_block_multiplicative` at all. It has a dedicated `after_modify_block_amount` method (paels_legion.py:53-66), dispatched by `HookSystem.after_modify_block_amount` (hooks.py:840-858) from `BlockCmd.apply` (cmds.py:499-500) -- a genuine second hook, matching C#'s split between `Hook.ModifyBlock`/`ModifyBlockMultiplicative` and the separate `Hook.AfterModifyingBlockAmount` (Hook.cs:649-659). Both of the guards this entry found missing are present in that method: (a) `if amount <= 0: return` (paels_legion.py:60) mirrors PaelsLegion.cs:157's `modifiedAmount <= 0m` return, and the `amount` passed in is `cmds.py`'s already-clamped `max(0, amount)` (cmds.py:494), matching CreatureCmd.cs:644's clamp-before-dispatch order exactly; (b) `if self._affected_card is not None and self._affected_card is not card: return` (paels_legion.py:64) mirrors PaelsLegion.cs:165's `AffectedCardPlay != null && AffectedCardPlay != cardPlay`. (c) is unchanged and was never the gap: `hooks.py`'s `modifiers` list already only contained listeners whose factor changed the value. EXECUTED (`.superpowers/sdd/unlabelled/probes/relic-6-checks.py`): a card-sourced block gain that resolves to 0 does not arm the cooldown (`probe_paels_legion_latch_zero`, cooldown stays 0 where the stale record predicted 2); a second (inner) card's block gain does not steal the first (outer) card's latch (`probe_paels_legion_latch_nested`); an asleep relic (factor 1.0) is never notified (`probe_paels_legion_modifiers_gate`). This record's guard text pre-dates that fix and was never regenerated -- the exact stale-rollup shape round 11 exists to catch.

guards.what: N1: the pet creature. C# summons a real MonsterModel onto the player's side (PlayerCmd.AddPet, PaelsLegion.cs:221-224) at both AfterObtained and BeforeCombatStart; the sim models the pet as the adds_pet FLAG only and puts no creature in the combat
guards.rationale: The port's docstring claims the pet is cosmetic; CHECKED rather than accepted (PROMPT.md bug class 12). src/Core/Models/Monsters/PaelsLegion.cs is 9999 MinInitialHp / 9999 MaxInitialHp (:19-21), `IsHealthBarVisible => false` (:23), and its move state machine is a single self-looping `NOTHING_MOVE` that returns Task.CompletedTask (:33-38); everything else in the file is SetupSkins and GenerateAnimator, i.e. Spine skins and animation states. It has no powers, no intent and no HP the player can reach, and the block doubling lives entirely on the RELIC. So the omission is presentation, and the one mechanical consequence of a pet existing -- HasEventPet gating the shrine option -- is carried by adds_pet. Waived under the presentation exclusion with the executed/read basis stated, not under a bare 'the sim has no pets' claim, which binding rule 1 would make a gap.
